newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE amends trading for UK budget.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE amends trading for UK budget.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Monday it had amended trading on July 2 for the British budget.
Floor trading for gilt futures and options will close at 1515 GMT as usual but floor trading for short sterling futures and options will be extended to 1515 from 1505.

Automated Pit Trading (APT) for gilt futures will begin at 1522 GMT instead of 1530 GMT and close as normal at 1700 GMT. APT trading for short sterling futures will begin at 1524 GMT instead of 1522 and finishes as usual at 1657 GMT.
Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown will begin his speech at 1430 GMT.
